en.ui.sketch3d.axis_help: Ctrl or Toggle Axis cycles X → Y → Z. Hold Shift for free placement in the view plane through the start. Release Shift to restore the lock.
en.ui.sketch3d.confirm_help: Apply completes the current chain and keeps the tool active. OK completes it and exits the tool. Cancel discards pending input; completed segments remain. The sketch stays open. The highlighted button remembers this tool’s last confirmation.
en.ui.sketch3d.incomplete: Complete the required points before applying, or Cancel to discard pending input.
